backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (Listing, UserProfile, ChatThread, Notification, Report, SellWizardDraft) and state maps for a campus marketplace, with mixins for blob storage and authorization, plus recommendation and analytics types.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (redesigned UI, advanced search/filtering, urgent sale tags, campus meetup suggestions) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose, including routing, layouts, auth guards, API hooks, components, and pages with implementation details.
frontend/docs/ic-ops-and-export.md: Guide for managing deployed Internet Computer canisters, including instructions for stopping, disabling, or taking canisters offline with prerequisites and methods.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, sidebar).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting the app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/api/actorClient.ts: Thin wrapper around useActor hook that logs actor readiness timing and records startup diagnostics when the actor becomes available.
frontend/src/api/aiAssist.ts: React Query hook to check if AI assist is enabled via actor.isAIAssistEnabled() with 5-minute cache and error handling.
frontend/src/api/chat.ts: Provides React Query hooks for chat operations (threads, messages) with dev-bypass mode support that returns empty/null data and shows toast notifications when chat is disabled.
frontend/src/api/insights.ts: Exports a React Query hook to fetch stubbed analytics data from the backend actor for insights display.
frontend/src/api/listings.ts: Provides React Query hooks for listing CRUD operations with automatic fallback to mock data in dev-bypass or mock mode, including search, save/unsave, and seller filtering.
frontend/src/api/notifications.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching notifications and marking them as read via the backend actor.
frontend/src/api/profile.ts: Provides hooks for fetching and saving user profiles with dev-bypass mode support (returns stub profile), includes performance timing instrumentation and profile caching.
frontend/src/api/queries.ts: Defines centralized query key factory for React Query cache management across listings, profile, chat, notifications, and insights.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the app with ThemeProvider (light mode), AuthProvider, CursorReactiveLayer, router, and Toaster, plus startup diagnostics and profile cache hydration on mount.
frontend/src/app/effects/CursorReactiveL: Renders an invisible, disabled canvas component that was previously used for cursor glow effects but is now fully disabled while kept in codebase.
frontend/src/app/effects/useReducedMotio: Hook that detects user's prefers-reduced-motion setting via media query and returns boolean state.
frontend/src/app/guards/AuthModeGate.tsx: Route guard that redirects unauthenticated users to login page while allowing public paths, with performance timing instrumentation for auth initialization.
frontend/src/app/guards/DevOnlyRouteGate: Route guard that restricts access to development-only routes, redirecting to home in production builds.
frontend/src/app/guards/OnboardingGate.t: Route guard that redirects users to onboarding if profile is incomplete, with timeout fallback and dev guest mode support.
frontend/src/app/interactions/pullToRefr: Container component that wraps children with pull-to-refresh UI, displaying a loader during pull gesture.
Touch-only hook that detects pull-down gestures at top of scroll and triggers refresh callback when threshold is exceeded.
frontend/src/app/layout/AppShell.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that combines TopBar, main content area, and BottomTabs navigation.
frontend/src/app/layout/BottomTabs.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Search, Sell, Cart (with badge), and Chats tabs; persists last visited tab to localStorage.
frontend/src/app/layout/TopBar.tsx: Sticky top header with back button, title, search, notifications, and user avatar dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/app/modals/ConfirmDiscardMo: Reusable alert dialog for confirming discard of unsaved changes with customizable title and description.
frontend/src/app/router.tsx: TanStack Router configuration with root route, public routes (splash, login), protected routes with AppShell, and lazy-loaded pages with suspense fallbacks.
frontend/src/app/routes.ts: Centralized route path constants and helper functions to extract listing/thread IDs from URL paths.
frontend/src/app/startup/PageSkeleton.ts: Lightweight skeleton placeholder UI for lazy-loaded pages showing grid of loading cards.
frontend/src/app/startup/ProfileTimeoutF: Fallback UI card displayed when profile loading exceeds timeout, offering retry or guest mode continuation.
frontend/src/app/startup/useProfileStart: Hook that triggers a 2-second timeout during profile loading and manages fallback UI state with retry/guest actions.
frontend/src/features/ai/provider/aiProv: AI provider abstraction that checks if AI assist is enabled and provides listing enhancement with deterministic fallback.
frontend/src/features/auth/AuthMode.ts: Configuration flag for AUTH_OFF mode that toggles between dev identity/localStorage and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Lo: Login/Logout button component that clears all persisted state (profile, searches, filters, drafts) on logout.
Client-side localStorage persistence for dev/guest mode flag used during startup failures.
frontend/src/features/auth/devModeDefaul: Provides a default anonymous user profile for dev-bypass/dev-guest mode, only available in development environment.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useCurr: Thin wrapper hook that re-exports the API hook for fetching the current user's profile.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/usePost: Hook that redirects authenticated users to home or onboarding based on profile completion status; dev-bypass skips profile check.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/AuthPr: React context provider for pluggable authentication that manages session state, sign-in/sign-out operations, and defaults to a stub Supabase provider.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/authSt: localStorage helpers for persisting and retrieving auth session data with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/authTy: TypeScript interfaces defining the auth plugin abstraction including AuthSession, AuthProvider, and AuthContextValue types.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/provid: Bridge adapter that wraps Internet Identity authentication into the new pluggable auth system.
Placeholder Supabase auth provider that supports dev-bypass email authentication and persists sessions to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/useAut: React hook to access the auth context with error handling for usage outside provider.
Helper functions for caching and retrieving user profile data in localStorage.
frontend/src/features/cart/components/Ca: Card component displaying cart summary with listing previews, total price, and navigation to full cart view.
frontend/src/features/cart/hooks/useCart: React hook managing cart state with add/remove/clear operations and cross-tab synchronization via storage events.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Qu: Button component for inserting quick offer templates into chat messages.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Sm: UI component rendering contextual smart reply suggestions as clickable chips based on conversation history.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Th: Card component displaying a chat thread preview with avatar, last message, timestamp, and unread badge.
frontend/src/features/chat/readReceipts/: Helper function computing read receipt status text ('Seen') for the last message in a chat thread.
frontend/src/features/chat/smartReplies/: Generates contextual smart reply suggestions based on keywords in the last message content.
frontend/src/features/chat/typing/useTyp: React hook publishing typing status to backend with debouncing to limit update frequency.
frontend/src/features/checkout/checkoutS: SessionStorage helpers for persisting and retrieving checkout data including seller groups and totals.
frontend/src/features/checkout/splitBySe: Groups cart listings by seller, computes subtotals, and provides extension point for future multi-seller payment routing.
frontend/src/features/discovery/componen: Horizontal scrollable strip component displaying recently viewed listings fetched from localStorage and backend.
Displays a horizontally scrollable section of recommended listings (items 6-12 from the listings API) with a Sparkles icon header, using ListingCard components with optimistic save toggling.
Renders personalized suggestions in a grid layout using heuristics based on saved listings and user signals, with staggered fade-in animations for each card.
Displays a horizontally scrollable section of trending listings (first 6 items from the listings API) with a TrendingUp icon header and skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/features/discovery/feeds/fe: Implements deterministic scoring algorithms for trending and recommended feeds based on recently viewed items, search history, saved listings, and category preferences stored in local persistence.
frontend/src/features/discovery/suggesti: Generates personalized listing suggestions by scoring categories based on user's saved items, viewed history, and search terms, filtering out already-interacted listings and returning top 8 results.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Da: Renders a 4-column grid of quick action cards (Sell, Search, Trending, Insights) with icons and hover animations that navigate to respective routes.
Displays a 3-column grid showing user statistics (Saved items count, Cart count, My Listings count) as clickable cards that navigate to their respective pages.

Shows three exploration widgets in a grid: Continue Browsing (recent views), Top Categories (category badges), and Marketplace Insights (active listings count), all clickable to navigate to relevant pages.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Ma: Displays a scrolling marquee banner with safety and welcome announcements using CSS animations in a gradient card with a megaphone icon.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Pe: Displays a personalized preview of up to 4 listings scored by recently viewed items, recent searches, and saved item categories, with skeleton loading states and staggered animations.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Sa: Renders a horizontal scrollable strip of saved listings with thumbnails, titles, and prices, hidden when empty or loading.
frontend/src/features/listings/aiAssist/: Displays AI-generated suggestions for improving listing fields (title, description, price) with apply buttons in a card layout.
Generates rule-based suggestions for improving listing titles, descriptions, and prices based on condition, category, and content length.
Provides a panel to generate and apply AI-enhanced title and description suggestions for listings, with regenerate functionality.
frontend/src/features/listings/component: Bottom sheet component for filtering listings by category and sort order with clear and apply actions.
Displays a listing card with image, title, price, condition badge, save/cart buttons, and hover animations; includes skeleton variant.
Renders listing images with error handling, lazy loading support, and fallback for blob URLs or direct URLs.
A carousel component for displaying listing images with navigation controls, pagination indicators, and fallback UI for empty image arrays.
frontend/src/features/listings/edit/Edit: Form component for editing existing listings with validation, AI assist integration, and fields for title, description, price, condition, category, and images.
frontend/src/features/listings/filters/h: Custom hook managing home feed filters (category, price range, sort) with URL sync, localStorage persistence, and client-side filtering/sorting logic.
frontend/src/features/listings/hooks/use: Hook for toggling saved/unsaved state of listings with optimistic UI updates and toast notifications.
frontend/src/features/listings/mock/mock: Static array of mock listing data with sample products (iPhone, textbooks, furniture, shoes, MacBook) for development and testing.
In-memory mock client simulating backend API calls for listings with simulated latency and CRUD operations.
Development-only mock mode toggle using localStorage and environment variables, strictly disabled in production builds.
frontend/src/features/listings/myListing: Card component displaying user's own listings with status badges, thumbnail image, and action buttons for viewing and editing.
frontend/src/features/listings/sellWizar: Helper function that maps an existing Listing object to SellWizardFormData format for duplicating listings.
Image upload component with drag-and-drop reordering, file selection, preview thumbnails, and remove functionality with configurable max images.
Main multi-step wizard form component for creating/editing listings with progress tracking, validation, AI assist integration, and navigation between four steps (basic info, pricing, images, review).
TypeScript type definitions and constants for the sell wizard including form data shape, wizard steps enum, and predefined condition/category options.
Validation functions for each wizard step that check required fields, length constraints, and numeric ranges, returning structured error objects.
First wizard step component collecting title, category, and condition with validation error display.
Third wizard step component for uploading up to 5 listing photos using the ImagePicker component.
Second wizard step component for entering price and description with character count and validation.
Final wizard step displaying a read-only summary of all entered listing data including photos, title, price, category, condition, and description.
React hook that automatically saves form data to local storage every 4 seconds and provides draft restoration/clearing functions.
frontend/src/features/notifications/comp: Displays a single notification card with type-specific icons, read/unread styling, and relative timestamps for messages, sales, price changes, and system notifications.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/re: Core recommendation engine that provides trending, personalized, similar category, and collaborative filtering recommendations using heuristic algorithms without external API calls.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/us: React hook that fetches listings and saved items, then computes recommendations based on specified type and context using the recommendation provider.
frontend/src/features/saved/savedSorting: Defines SavedFilters interface and applySavedFilters function to filter listings by category and sort by recent, price-low, or price-high.
frontend/src/features/saved/SavedToolbar: Filter and sort toolbar for saved listings with category dropdown, sort options (recent/price), and clear filters button.
frontend/src/features/search/autosuggest: Implements a dual-layer cache (memory + sessionStorage) for autosuggest results with 5-minute TTL and functions to get, set, and clear cached suggestions.
Generates autosuggest results by matching query against recent searches, listing titles, and categories, caching results and limiting to 5 suggestions.
frontend/src/features/search/components/: Renders an autosuggest dropdown with keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape) and click selection for search suggestions.
Displays clickable category chips (textbooks, furniture, electronics, etc.) with emoji icons for filtering listings by category.
Shows a panel of recent searches with individual delete buttons and a clear-all option, allowing users to quickly re-run past searches.
Provides a filter bar with sort dropdown (relevance, price, newest) and active filter badges with clear functionality.
frontend/src/features/search/searchFilte: Implements client-side filtering and sorting for search results by category, price range, and sort order (relevance, newest, price-low, price-high).
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/badges: Renders UI-only badges (New Seller, Trusted, Fast Responder) with icons for displaying seller reputation indicators.
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/report: Provides a bottom sheet modal for reporting listings with radio button reason selection and submit/cancel actions.
Defines a fixed list of report reasons (spam, inappropriate, scam, duplicate, sold, other) for listing reports.
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/safety: Displays a safety tips alert banner reminding users to meet in public and avoid sharing financial information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark theme variables (warm earth tones), custom interactive utilities, and motion-safe animations with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers for React Query and ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with listing details, removal functionality, total calculation, and checkout navigation with safety reminders.
frontend/src/pages/ChatsInboxPage.tsx: Chat inbox page listing all user chat threads with loading states, error handling, and navigation to individual thread pages.
frontend/src/pages/ChatThreadPage.tsx: Individual chat thread page with message display, real-time message sending, scroll-to-bottom behavior, and authentication-aware error handling.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutConfirmationP: Order confirmation page displaying order summary, payment distribution across sellers, and clearing cart/checkout data after successful order placement.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Displays checkout page with cart items grouped by seller, shows order summary with totals, and navigates to confirmation page after storing checkout data in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/DevQaChecklistPage.ts: Development-only QA checklist page that provides mock mode toggle and quick navigation links to test various app flows like home feed, listing details, saved items, and notifications.
frontend/src/pages/EditListingPage.tsx: Allows users to edit an existing listing by fetching listing data, rendering an edit form, and handling submission with navigation back to the listing detail page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main dashboard page with pull-to-refresh, displaying stats, quick actions, announcements, saved items, personalized listings, trending and recommended sections.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Displays marketplace analytics including most popular category, most traded category, and other metrics with a time range selector (7/30/90 days).
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Shows detailed listing view with image carousel, save/cart actions, chat/report buttons, campus meetup locations, safety tips, and tracks recently viewed items.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Email-based login page with form validation, auth provider integration, post-login redirect handling, and displays placeholder info for development mode.
frontend/src/pages/MyListingsPage.tsx: Displays the current user's active listings with options to create new listings, showing loading states, empty states, and error handling for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Shows user notifications with click handlers that mark notifications as read and navigate to relevant pages (chats, listings) based on notification type.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx: Onboarding form for new users to complete their profile by entering campus, hostel, and department information before accessing the main app.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the current user's profile information including campus, hostel, and department with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/SavedPage.tsx: Shows user's saved listings with filtering/sorting toolbar, empty state prompts, and optimistic UI for toggling saved status.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Search interface with debounced input, autosuggestions, category filters, recent searches, and displays trending/recommended sections when no search is active.
frontend/src/pages/SellWizardPage.tsx: Multi-step form page for creating new listings or duplicating existing ones, handling submission to backend and navigation to my listings on success.
frontend/src/pages/SplashPage.tsx: Splash screen component that shows a loading spinner for 1.5s, then redirects authenticated users to their last visited tab or home, and unauthenticated users to login.
frontend/src/README-frontend-structure.m: Frontend architecture documentation covering the auth plugin system with dev-bypass mode, state management (React Query, local/session storage), discovery/recommendations, cart system, search, home dashboard, and placeholder for Chutes AI integration.
frontend/src/store/authOffPersistence.ts: Re-exports saved listings and recent searches persistence functions from new modular persistence modules for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/store/localStorage.ts: Versioned localStorage wrapper with prefixed keys, providing get/set/remove/clear operations with error handling and version migration support.
frontend/src/store/persistence/cart.ts: Cart persistence module managing up to 50 cart items with add/remove/clear operations and duplicate prevention.
frontend/src/store/persistence/cookies.t: Cookie preferences utility simulating cookies via localStorage for campus_slug, dark mode preference, and UI motion level settings.
frontend/src/store/persistence/homeFilte: Home feed filter persistence managing category, price range, and sort order with default values.
frontend/src/store/persistence/lastVisit: Persists the last visited bottom navigation tab (home/search/sell/chats/profile) for session restoration.
frontend/src/store/persistence/recentlyV: Tracks up to 20 recently viewed listings with timestamps, deduplication, and recency-based ordering.
frontend/src/store/persistence/recentSea: Manages up to 10 recent search terms with add, per-item delete, and clear-all operations.
frontend/src/store/persistence/savedList: Manages saved listings for unauthenticated users via localStorage with save/unsave/check/clear operations.
frontend/src/store/persistence/sellDraft: Persists sell wizard form draft data to localStorage with get/set/clear operations for autosave support.
frontend/src/store/persistence/storageKe: Centralized versioned storage key constants for all persistence layers including auth, cookies, discovery, user actions, UI state, and drafts.
frontend/src/theme/theme.md: Design system documentation defining CampusMarket's warm coral/amber color palette, typography scale, dark mode colors, and marketplace-focused visual philosophy.
frontend/src/utils/perfTimings.ts: Performance timing utility with safe guards for console and performance API availability, providing start/end/log methods for measuring execution time.
frontend/src/utils/startupDiagnostics.ts: Production-safe startup diagnostics logger that records and reports initialization stages with success/error/pending status and timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/src/utils/userFacingError.ts: Converts runtime and authorization errors into user-friendly error messages by detecting common error patterns like unauthorized access, network failures, and timeouts.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended spacing, typography, animations, and plugins for a modern design system.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a campus-specific secondhand marketplace with React/TypeScript frontend, Motoko backend on Internet Computer, featuring listings, messaging, favorites, and campus verification.
